title: Kneeling Ghoul in Theater
description: A grotesque, emaciated humanoid ghoul with pale skin, exposed ribs, and bloody mouth kneels on a wooden stage floor. It reaches toward a small wooden stool while blood and scattered papers lie around it in an abandoned theater with red curtains, empty folding chairs, and a large surreal maritime painting in the background.
prompt: A grotesque pale ghoul with exposed ribs and bloody mouth kneels on a wooden theater stage, reaching one clawed hand toward a small stool. Blood and papers are scattered on the floor. Behind it hangs a large dramatic painting of stormy seas with ships and ghostly figures. Red curtains frame the scene, empty folding chairs are scattered in the foreground, a vintage floor lamp illuminates the horror. Dark surreal horror atmosphere, cinematic lighting.
